policy.seed_unverified: A seed-unverified row records the implemented claim and its bounded primary-source check target; it is not a current-version assertion.
policy.verified: A verified row may assert only what the cited primary or official source confirmed on last_verified and what its bound source-derived vectors execute against the named calculator code.
